confidence: Medium-high for the top 4 (Reese's, M&M's, Snickers, Kit Kat), which every source agrees on. Ranks 5-12 reasonably firm; 13-24 tightly bunched (14.0-17.3) and interchangeable. Near misses: Heath, Krackel, Mounds, Swedish Fish, Rolo, Andes, 100 Grand, York, Ghirardelli, Hot Tamales, Tootsie Roll, Whoppers. Caveats: the favorite polls are Halloween-framed (inflates Candy Corn); Monmouth's closed list left out Kit Kat and Twix; YouGov H2H leans chocolate/older while CandyStore and Numerator lean Gen Z/fruity; pageviews are noisy; no open brand-level Circana bar sales were found.
